description: This file defines the interface VoicemailFilter, used for filtering voicemail queries in the voicemail helper system.

classes.name: VoicemailFilter
classes.description: An interface for applying filters on voicemail queries, providing a method to obtain a SQL WHERE clause.

methods.name: getWhereClause
methods.description: Returns the SQL where clause for this filter, or null if the filter is empty.
